'''Counter-Strike 2'''{{TH|2026-04-20 — '''Present'''|Team Falcons}} }} Finn "'''karrigan'''" Andersen {{born}} is a [[:Category:Denmark|Danish]]-[[:Category:Germany|German]] professional ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' player and a former ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' and ''[[Counter-Strike]]'' player who plays as the [[:Category:In-game leaders|in-game leader]] for [[Team Falcons]]. He is regarded as one of the most successful in-game leaders in ''Counter-Strike'' history, leading the [[Team SoloMid]]-[[Astralis]] core to multiple trophies before going on to make history by winning several trophies with the international [[FaZe Clan]] and [[mousesports]] lineups. After returning to [[FaZe Clan]] in 2021, he made history once again by being the first IGL to guide an international lineup to a [[Majors|Major]] victory, doing so at [[PGL Major Antwerp 2022]]. karrigan would leave FaZe in 2026 after 5 years with the team and sign to [[Team Falcons]], with whom he would win the [[IEM Cologne Major 2026]] just 61 days after joining. karrigan is among the most decorated players in the scene, having won over 20 [[S-Tier Tournaments|S-Tier]] tournaments throughout his career including two [[Majors]] and an [[Intel/Grand Slam/4|Intel Grand Slam]]. ==Gear and His partnership with [[KRIMZ]] during [[Fnatic]]'s dominant period from late 2014 to early 2016 is regarded as one of the best duos in ''Counter-Strike'' history. He is best known for his time in [[Fnatic]] and later [[FaZe Clan]]. '''Counter-Strike 2'''{{TH|2024-11-08 — 2025-01-18|Undone}} }} Tyler "'''Skadoodle'''" Latham {{born}} is an [[:Category:United_States|American]] professional ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' player and a former ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' player. Skadoodle first started competing professionally in ''Alliance of Valiant Arms''. He got his start in CS:GO with [[Hold Mouse One]], first playing in [[ESEA/Season_12/Invite|ESEA Invite Season 12]]. This team would eventually be signed by [[Team Curse]], later becoming [[iBUYPOWER]]. Under the [[iBUYPOWER]] banner, '''Skadoodle''' won two ESEA titles as well as two CEVO titles. In 2015, he was signed by [[Cloud9]]. Under [[Cloud9]], he most notably won an ESL Pro League title and became the first North American major champions, winning [[ELEAGUE/2018/Major|ELEAGUE Major Boston 2018]]. Skadoodle took a break from CS:GO in March 2018 but returned to [[Cloud9]] less than two weeks later. Six months later, he transitioned off of the roster to become a full-time streamer. On June 3rd 2020, it was announced by [[valorant:T1|T1]] that he was resuming his professional career, moving to ''[[:valorant:Skadoodle|VALORANT]]'', and reuniting with ex-[[iBUYPOWER]] teammates Braxton "[[swag]]" Pierce and Keven "[[AZK]]" Larivière on the new roster. ==Gear and Settings== {{Mouse settings table |date=2020-06-04 |ref= [https://streamelements.com/skadoodle/commands] |brand=Logitech |model=G PRO Wireless |desc=Ghost |dpi=400 |polling=500 |windows=6 |sensitivity=1.9 |zoom=1 |rawinput=On }} {{Hardware table |date=2020-06-04 |ref= [https://streamelements.com/skadoodle/commands] |mouse-brand=Logitech |mouse-model=G PRO Wireless |mouse-desc=Ghost |keyboard-brand=Logitech |keyboard-model=G PRO X |pad-brand=Logitech |pad-model=G640 |headset-brand=Logitech |headset-model=G PRO X |monitor-brand=ZOWIE |monitor-model=XL2540 |refresh-rate=240 |w=1024 |h=768 |scaling=Stretched }} ==Achievements== {{Player achievements table|player=Skadoodle}} ==Trivia== * While remaining teamless after the [[North American match fixing scandal]], he and Spencer "[[Hiko]]" Martin were potential candidates to form the international team that would become [[Team Kinguin]]. {{cite web|url=http://www.dbltap.com/posts/6004587-cs-go-roster-moves-that-never-happened-that-time-hiko-and-skadoodle-almost-joined-an-eu-superteam?ihgw?a_aid=47014|date=2018-03-15|title=CS:GO Roster Moves That Never Happened: That Time Hiko and Skadoodle Almost Joined an EU Superteam|author=[[DeKay]]|publisher=[[DBLTAP]]}} * Was ranked the 20th best player of 2015 by [[HLTV]]. {{cite web|url=https://www.hltv.org/news/16703/top-20-players-of-2015-skadoodle-20|title=Top 20 players of 2015: Skadoodle (20)|date=2016-01-01|author=[[LucasAM]]|publisher=[[HLTV]]}} * On March 16th, 2017, [[shroud]] revealed on his stream that '''Skadoodle''' was rushed to a hospital emergency room after passing out. '''Counter-Strike 2'''{{TH|2024-03-29 — 2024-05-31|Legacy|Stand-in}} {{TH|2026-08-11 — '''Present'''|Without a Roof}} }} Jacky 'Jake' "'''Stewie2K'''" Yip {{born}} is an [[:Category:United States|American]] professional ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' player and a former ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' player. He is one of the most decorated players in North America, despite having only played ''CS:GO'' since the summer of 2014. On January 11th, 2016, he joined [[Cloud9]]; although the announcement was met with criticism from both professionals and the public, '''Stewie2K''' soon became known as one of the best players in [[Cloud9]]. After two years on the roster and a [[Majors|Major]] title under his belt, he decided to move on and join Gabriel "[[FalleN]]" Toledo's [[SK Gaming]]/[[MIBR]] squad. Following months of up-and-down results, he returned to his North American roots and joined [[Team Liquid]]. '''Counter-Strike 2'''{{TH|2024-03-16 — '''Present'''|MOUZ|Assistant Coach}} }} Andreas "'''Xyp9x'''" Højsleth {{born}} is a [[:Category:Denmark|Danish]] professional ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' assistant coach, a former professional ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' player, and a former semi-professional ''[[Counter-Strike]]'' player. He is famous for his high success rate in clutches, being dubbed the "clutch minister" by the community. Xyp9x was a member of the legendary [[Astralis]] dynasty from 2018 to 2020. He won over 20 [[S-Tier Tournaments|S-Tier]] tournaments as a player throughout his career, including four [[Majors|Major championships]] and an [[Intel/Grand Slam/1|Intel Grand Slam]]. ==Gear and '''Counter-Strike 2'''{{TH|2026-01-06 — '''Present'''|100 Thieves}} }} Nicolai "'''dev1ce'''" Reedtz (formerly known as '''device''' and '''devve''' prior to 2016) {{born}} is a [[:Category:Denmark|Danish]] professional ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' player and a former professional ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' and ''[[Counter-Strike: Source]]'' player currently playing for [[100 Thieves]]. He is regarded as one of the best players and AWPers of all time, known for his highly consistent and calculated style of play. dev1ce was a member of the legendary [[Astralis]] dynasty from 2018 to 2020. He has won 25 [[S-Tier Tournaments|S-Tier]] tournaments across his career, including four [[Majors|Major championships]] and an [[ESL/Grand Slam|ESL Grand Slam]]. dev1ce has won 19 [[HLTV/MVP Awards|HLTV MVP]] awards, including two major MVPs and has also ranked nine times in the [[HLTV/Top_20_Players|HLTV Top 20 ranking]], peaking at #2 in 2018. ==Gear and Settings== {{Mouse settings table |date=2021-04-23 |ref=[https://nip.gl/pages/player-dev1ce dev1ce - CS:GO - NIP Player]{{cite web|url=https://youtu.be/taAg_0ul-xI|title=Dev1ce's first day as a Ninja! | NIP BACKSTAGE|date=2021-04-25|author=[[Ninjas in Pyjamas]]}} |brand=ZOWIE |model=EC2 |dpi=400 |polling=1000 |sensitivity=2 |zoom=1.1 |windows=6 |rawinput=On }} {{Hardware table |date=2021-04-23 |ref= |mouse-brand=ZOWIE |mouse-model=EC2 |pad-brand=Logitech |pad-model=G640 |keyboard-brand=Logitech |keyboard-model=G PRO X |headset-brand=Razer|headset-model=Blackshark V3 Pro |monitor-brand=ZOWIE |monitor-model=XL2546 |refresh-rate=240 |w=1280|h=960 |scaling=Stretched }} {{Crosshair table |date=2023-02-26 |ref={{cite web|url=https://www.hltv.org/matches/2362088/saw-vs-astralis-blasttv-paris-major-2023-europe-rmr-closed-qualifier-a|title=BLAST.tv Paris Major 2023 Europe RMR Closed Qualifier A|date=2026-02-26|publisher=[[HLTV]]}} |share_code=CSGO-4N7Nk-GqUXY-FAjqX-AAo78-DHPYE }} ==Achievements== {{Player achievements table|player=dev1ce}} ==Trivia== ===Personal=== *Changed his nickname from "'''device'''" to "'''devve'''" on January 2, 2016.
